qa.question: Is a second source needed for the Chickasha cancellation?
qa.finding: The Chickasha Economic Development Authority release page (https://chickashaedc.com/2025/06/governor-stitt-chickasha-leaders-celebrate-largest-private-investment-in-city-history-with-announcement-of-new-industrial-park) carries the note that the project was cancelled as of early 2026 due to site limitations. qa.recommendation: Keep cancelled, as a single-source status change. Ask the Chickasha authority or search the Express-Star for a second report.
